hero.tagline: Beauty & skin care in the heart of the Allgäu

whoWeAre.title: Who we are
whoWeAre.p1: We are a small cosmetic procedures cabinet in the old town of Füssen, at the foot of the Alps. Our certified estheticians combine years of experience with ongoing training in modern cosmetic techniques.
whoWeAre.p2: We believe in honest advice, medical-grade hygiene and treatments that respect your skin. Every visit starts with a personal consultation — no upselling, just what your skin actually needs.

consultation.title: Honest consultation
consultation.text: Every visit starts with a personal skin consultation — we recommend only what your skin actually needs.

hygiene.title: Medical-grade hygiene
hygiene.text: Certified products, sterile single-use materials and clinical hygiene standards at every step.

technology.title: Modern equipment
technology.text: Gentle, up-to-date apparative treatments with proven results — no experiments on your skin.

location.title: Heart of Füssen
location.text: In the old town at the foot of the Alps, minutes from Reichenstraße — easy to reach, easy to park.

team.title: Our team
team.intro: Certified estheticians who love what they do — and keep learning it.

ctaBand.title: Ready for your me-time?
ctaBand.text: Book online in two minutes — choose a service, a specialist and a time that suits you.

facial.title: Facial treatments
facial.description: Deep cleansing, hydrating and anti-aging facials tailored to your skin type.

permanentMakeup.title: Permanent make-up
permanentMakeup.description: Natural-looking brows, lips and eyeliner with gentle, precise pigmentation.

laser.title: Laser & apparative cosmetics
laser.description: Modern apparative treatments for skin rejuvenation and hair removal.

nails.title: Manicure & pedicure
nails.description: Classic and medical nail care with long-lasting gel finishes.

lashesBrows.title: Lash & brow styling
lashesBrows.description: Lifting, lamination, tinting and extensions for an effortless everyday look.

body.title: Body treatments
body.description: Relaxing massages, peelings and firming treatments for skin and body.

consent.title: Cookies & external services
consent.description: We only use storage that is technically required (your language and this cookie decision). The Altegio booking calendar is an external service that sets cookies when it loads — we load it only with your consent. You can change your choice at any time under “Cookie settings” in the footer.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We take the protection of your personal data seriously. This notice explains what data we process on this website, why we process it, and the rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

controller.title: Controller
controller.body: The controller responsible for processing personal data on this website is {{businessName}}, {{address}}. E-mail: {{email}}, phone: {{phone}}.

hosting.title: Access data
hosting.body: When you visit this site, technical access data (IP address, date and time, browser type) is processed in server logs to deliver the site securely and detect abuse (Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR). Log data is deleted after a short period and is not merged with other data.

contactForm.title: Contact form
contactForm.body: If you use the contact form, we store your name, e-mail address and message in order to answer your enquiry (Art. 6 (1) (b) GDPR). Messages are deleted once your enquiry is resolved, at the latest after 12 months.

booking.title: Online booking and payments (Altegio)
booking.body: Appointments are booked through the external service Altegio (alteg.io). The booking calendar is embedded only after you give consent (Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR). Once loaded, Altegio processes your IP address and sets cookies, and the data you enter — name, phone number, e-mail, selected service and, for online payments, your payment details — is processed by Altegio on its own pages. Please refer to Altegio's privacy policy for details. Booking requests made through our site are additionally stored by us so our staff can follow up. You can withdraw your consent at any time via “Cookie settings” in the footer.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.body: This website sets no tracking cookies of its own. We use your browser's local storage for two strictly functional purposes: your language preference (i18nextLng) and your cookie decision (cookie-consent). Functional storage of this kind requires no consent. Cookies from Altegio are set only after you accept the booking calendar.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your personal data, to receive a copy of it, to restrict or object to its processing, and to withdraw any consent with effect for the future. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority; the authority competent for us is the Bavarian Data Protection Authority (BayLDA).

imprint.title: Imprint
imprint.dispute: The European Commission provides a platform for online dispute resolution: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr. We are neither obliged nor willing to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board.
